data.current_description: New transfers remain cancellable until auto_finish_at (normally about five minutes), then send automatically. Disclose the recipient amount/currency if conversion applies. Use a fresh Idempotency-Key for each new intent; after 202 CREATING or an indeterminate timeout, retry only the identical request with the SAME key. Wait retry_after_seconds if supplied, or inspect the transfer list. A fresh key in this case can duplicate the transfer. QUOTE_EXPIRED needs a new request with a fresh key. Generate, keep and reuse your own key.
data.description_suggestion: Create a new P2P transfer to send funds to a recipient. The transfer remains cancellable for approximately five minutes (until auto_finish_at), after which it automatically settles. If currency conversion applies, disclose the converted recipient amount. Use an Idempotency-Key header to ensure idempotent requests: use a fresh key for each new transfer intent, and reuse the same key only for retries of the identical request. Returns 202 CREATING for async processing, 201 for immediate completion, or 200 for quote responses. If QUOTE_EXPIRED is returned, submit a new request with a fresh Idempotency-Key. Check retry_after_seconds in the response to determine retry timing.

Security note: The eid grants token access to any holder, so avoid logging it.
